purpose: Reproducible OAS seam input for aweb release tests: released v0.20 upstream main plus the three aweb seams proposed upstream as OAS PRs 37, 48 and 69 (Pi task ordering, launch environment contract, retirement cleanup evidence).
tradeoff: The default no longer exercises uncommitted or newer local OAS integration work; pass OAS_TEST_ROOT explicitly for that opt-in coverage.
retention: Pinned through an aweb-controlled mirror rather than the upstream repository. The previous pin's ancestor lived on an upstream branch that was deleted, which invalidated the pin and forced a full rebuild. Upstream branch retention is not ours to promise, so the pin resolves from a repository we control.
verification: A pinned tree must be able to start an agent. Prove that by executing a real spawn, not by inspecting the constructed command line: the defect this pin previously carried was invisible to the whole suite because nothing ever ran the command.
